prompt: I am thinking of a Ancient Roman City.  The city was destroyed by volcanic eruption.  The eruption occurred in the year 79 AD.  The volcano was a stratovolcano.    Where was the session held where it was decided that the city would be named a UNESCO world heritage site?
answer:
The city was **Pompeii**, destroyed in the **79 CE eruption of Mount Vesuvius**. Its UNESCO designation was decided at the **21st session of the UNESCO World Heritage Committee**, held in **Naples, Italy, from December 1–6, 1997**.  

The site was inscribed as the **“Archaeological Areas of Pompeii, Herculaneum and Torre Annunziata.”**
